summary: United Community Banks, Inc. (UCB) filed an 8-K announcing a definitive merger agreement to acquire Peach State Bancshares, Inc. and its bank subsidiary. The transaction will be structured as Peach State merging into UCB, followed by Peach State Bank & Trust merging into United Community Bank. The filing includes a joint press release and an investor presentation. Key terms (price, premium, consideration) are not specified in the excerpt. The boards have approved the deal, which is subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions. The expected close timeline is not given. Watch for regulatory filings, shareholder votes, and the exchange ratio or cash consideration details in the investor presentation.
